_comment: Thresholds for eval-gate. Changes must always go through a PR (this change itself is Tier 2). The judge binarizes each axis's graded score (correctness / faithfulness / completeness) at judge.pass_score and gates on the pass rate per axis. Axes are never summed. The values are initial design examples; calibrate them by measuring agreement with human judgments (references/eval-design.md).
